# tafhc.org, LLM context file

## About this site
tafhc.org is The Alliance for Healthcare Competition, a 501(c)(6) trade association. The Alliance unites
independent physicians with employers, payers and manufacturers to remove the federal rules that let
consolidated hospital systems set prices without a competitor. It lobbies on three federal fights and
publishes research on more. Every figure on the site carries its source and an as-of date.

## The three fights
- Site-neutral payment: https://tafhc.org/fights/site-neutral/
- 340B reform: https://tafhc.org/fights/340b/
- Physician ownership (Section 6001 repeal): https://tafhc.org/fights/physician-ownership/
- The Tracker (every bill, rule and court case, two lanes): https://tafhc.org/tracker/

## Research
Produced for the Alliance under contract by Rojas Media, an independent research firm. The Alliance owns
and publishes the work.
- Research hub: https://tafhc.org/research/
- Cost drivers: https://tafhc.org/drivers/
- States (50-state map, state dossiers): https://tafhc.org/states/
- Health systems (subsidy ledgers): https://tafhc.org/systems/
- Academic medical centers: https://tafhc.org/academic/
- Physician-owned hospitals desk: https://tafhc.org/poh/
- Government (committee dossiers): https://tafhc.org/government/
- The hospital lobby (AHA, FAH, HAC dossiers): https://tafhc.org/lobby/
- Insights (reports, briefs, data, with PDFs): https://tafhc.org/insights/
- Methodology: https://tafhc.org/methodology/
- Corrections: https://tafhc.org/corrections/

## Certificate of need (CON) desk
Structured data and analysis on CON laws across 36 jurisdictions: the 35 that still require a permit
(34 states and DC) plus Florida. CON is research; the Alliance does not lobby on it.
- CON desk: https://tafhc.org/con/
- Rankings (51 jurisdictions, scored 0 to 100 by the Cicero Institute): https://tafhc.org/con/rankings/
- Scope matrix (36 jurisdictions by 9 facility categories): https://tafhc.org/con/scope/
- State comparison tool: https://tafhc.org/con/compare/
- Evidence (FTC and DOJ findings): https://tafhc.org/con/evidence/
- Reform tracker: https://tafhc.org/con/reform/
- Reform outcomes (Florida 2019, Montana 2021, South Carolina 2024): https://tafhc.org/con/outcomes/
- Timeline, 1946 to 2025: https://tafhc.org/con/timeline/
- CON methodology: https://tafhc.org/con/methodology/
- State pages: https://tafhc.org/con/[state-slug]/ and https://tafhc.org/states/[state-slug]/

## Data sources
Federal Register, Congress.gov, CBO, GAO, MedPAC, CMS, HRSA, IRS Form 990 filings, Senate Lobbying
Disclosure Act filings, FEC, Cicero Institute, NASHP, FTC, DOJ, Institute for Justice, Mercatus Center,
NBER, state health departments, and the Alliance's own analysis. Each page lists its sources.
